programme.desc: S07 E07 — Goodbye Trailer, Hello Dream Home Newlyweds trade in their double-wide for a dream home fit for their family; juggling wedding plans and bold design ideas isn't easy, so Brian and Mika look to help them build a forever home and find wedded bliss along the way!
programme.title: 100 Day Dream Home

programme.desc: S07 E05 — Now We're Cooking A professional chef and his wife are trading snowy Boston for sunny Florida; but when the kitchen of his dreams is far from a reality, Brian and Mika are left trying to cook up a plan to keep things from boiling over.
programme.title: 100 Day Dream Home

programme.desc: S07 E01 — Room for Mom A couple looks to build an addition to their home, so his mom can move in; design sparks fly when he wants all white, and she craves bold color in their new main suite, so Brian and Mika are challenged to create a space that makes everyone happy.
programme.title: 100 Day Dream Home

programme.desc: S07 E02 — One With Nature An animal-loving family looks to build a dream home, but they're clashing over style; he wants bold colors, but she loves white and as tensions rise, Brian and Mika work on a fun surprise they hope everyone will enjoy.
programme.title: 100 Day Dream Home

programme.desc: S01 E07 — Beach House Blues Leslie and Jasmine take on a beach house that's more regret than retreat in Redondo Beach, California. Jasmine needs to navigate tacky furniture and overall neglect to salvage this sinking rental.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Cottage Comeback Leslie travels to Temecula, Calif., and checks into a rental with more red flags than a wine tasting has red wines; filthy shag carpeting and an unsafe sleeping loft leave Jasmine starting from scratch to revive this once cozy cottage.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Star-Quality Studio In Los Angeles, Leslie finds herself in a garage studio that's more crash pad than Hollywood glamor; with fake bamboo and old, bulky furnishings, this rental needs a head-to-toe redesign from Jasmine to make it an elegant rental fit for a celebrity.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S01 E06 — Eco-Lodge Rescue Leslie checks into an eco-lodge that's more stress than serenity in Highland Park, Calif.; with no dedicated space for yoga and neglected outdoor areas, Jasmine looks to transform this rental into the peaceful retreat it promised to be.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S153 E08 — Trick or Treat in Atlanta A jet-setting single woman is looking for her first home base in the millennial-magnet neighborhood of Buckhead in Atlanta, Ga.; she wants to find a townhouse cozy enough for herself, her future dog and her extensive collection of Halloween décor.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S195 E07 — Room for Mom in Tucson A Tucson, Ariz., couple search for a bigger home now that her mother is moving in; he prefers a place that's move-in ready with an updated kitchen, but she wants a fixer-upper and plenty of yard space for her outrageous Halloween decorations.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S278 E12 — Bring On the Ghosts A proud country gal is ready to find a second property in the Kentucky wilderness. She wants plenty of land to hunt and fish with her daughter and for a potential side business, but her friend is concerned that she may be taking on too much.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S212 E10 — Searching in Salem A couple moves back to the wife's hometown of Salem, Mass., and though she wants the charm of a house with history, her husband with modern preferences learns about the rarity of new construction in old New England.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Welcome to the Haunted House Six designers tackle one of America's haunted houses while living in it; the scariest part isn't facing the spirits, but the four-day deadline to renovate two bedrooms, the risk of elimination and missing out on the chance to win $50,000.
programme.title: A Very Haunted Renovation

programme.desc: S181 E09 — Only Good Vibes in Puerto Vallarta An Arizona mother who claims to be psychic looks to make a drastic change and move with her kids to Puerto Vallarta, Mexico; she wants a lot of space for a little money, but her ability to sense a home's past energies only complicates the search.
programme.title: House Hunters International
